title: Admin - Comment Moderation - AI Spam Detection - Functional Test Plan
overview: Functional testing of the Admin Comment Moderation - AI Spam Detection feature on the Y4J platform. This system feature detects spam indicators including external URLs, suspicious phone numbers, promotional keywords, and excessive punctuation. Detected spam is flagged or blocked, with severe spam marked as 'Device Matcher Blocked'. Admins can override system decisions. Covers detection types, blocking behavior, admin override, and edge cases.

testCases.title: External URLs are detected and flagged
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Content containing external URLs has been submitted.
steps: Find a card with content containing external URLs (e.g., 'Visit http://example.com for deals')
expectedResults: The content with external URLs is flagged by the system
The URL is highlighted or marked as a spam indicator
Device Matcher Notes explain the URL detection
The item has a review-required status (Needs Review or Device Matcher Blocked)
testCases.postconditions: External URL content is confirmed flagged

testCases.title: Suspicious phone numbers are flagged
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Content containing phone numbers has been submitted.
steps: Find a card with content containing suspicious phone numbers (e.g., 'Call 9876543210 for free products')
expectedResults: The content with suspicious phone numbers is flagged
The phone number is identified as a spam indicator
Device Matcher Notes explain the phone number detection
The item is marked for review
testCases.postconditions: Phone number content is confirmed flagged

testCases.title: Promotional keywords trigger spam detection
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Content with promotional language has been submitted.
steps: Find a card with promotional content (e.g., 'Buy now! 50% off! Limited time offer!')
expectedResults: The promotional content is flagged by the spam detection system
Promotional keywords are identified as spam indicators
Device Matcher Notes explain the promotional language detection
The item is marked for review or blocked

testCases.title: Severe spam is marked 'Device Matcher Blocked'
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Content with severe spam indicators has been submitted.
steps: Find a card with severe spam (multiple indicators: URLs + phone + promotional language)
expectedResults: The severe spam content shows 'Device Matcher Blocked' status badge
The content is automatically blocked (not just flagged for review)
Device Matcher Notes explain the blocking reason
The content is NOT visible to users while blocked
testCases.postconditions: Severe spam is confirmed blocked with correct status

testCases.title: Admin can override system decision - approve blocked content
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. A 'Device Matcher Blocked' item exists.
steps: Find a card with 'Device Matcher Blocked' status
expectedResults: An override/approve action is available on blocked items
Clicking it changes the status from 'Device Matcher Blocked' to 'Approved'
The content becomes visible to users after admin override
The admin's decision overrides the AI system
A confirmation may be required before override

testCases.title: Admin can confirm system block - reject content
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. A flagged/blocked spam item exists.
expectedResults: A 'Reject' action is available
Clicking it changes the status to 'Rejected'
The content remains hidden from users
The rejection is recorded permanently

testCases.title: Excessive punctuation triggers spam detection
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Content with excessive punctuation has been submitted.
steps: Find a card with excessive punctuation (e.g., 'BUY NOW!!!! BEST DEAL EVER!!!!')
expectedResults: Content with excessive punctuation is flagged
The system identifies it as a spam indicator
Device Matcher Notes mention the excessive punctuation

testCases.title: Legitimate content without spam indicators is not flagged
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Clean legitimate content exists.
steps: Find a card with legitimate content (genuine review or query without spam indicators)
expectedResults: Legitimate content is NOT flagged as spam
No 'Device Matcher Blocked' status is applied
The content may have 'Ready to Approve' status
No false positives for genuine content
testCases.postconditions: Legitimate content is confirmed not flagged

testCases.title: Government scheme references are not flagged as spam (edge case)
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Content referencing government schemes has been submitted.
steps: Find content that references government schemes (e.g., 'Available under ADIP scheme by Govt of India')
Observe if it was incorrectly flagged as spam
expectedResults: Government scheme references are NOT flagged as spam (false positive avoided)
OR if flagged, the admin can easily override
The system distinguishes between legitimate government references and promotional spam
This is documented as a known behavior

testCases.title: URL shorteners are detected (edge case)
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Content with URL shorteners has been submitted.
expectedResults: URL shorteners are detected as potential spam indicators
They are flagged similarly to full URLs
Device Matcher Notes mention the shortened URL
OR if not detected, this is documented as a limitation

testCases.title: Blocked items appear in appropriate filter
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Device Matcher Blocked items exist.
expectedResults: Device Matcher Blocked items appear in the moderation list
They are accessible for admin review
The 'Device Matcher Blocked' status badge is clearly visible
Admin can take action (approve/reject) on these items
testCases.postconditions: Blocked items are accessible for admin review

testCases.title: Device Matcher Notes provide clear spam explanation
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. A spam-flagged item exists.
expectedResults: Device Matcher Notes clearly explain what triggered the spam detection
The notes specify which indicators were found (URL, phone, promotional language)
The explanation helps the admin make an informed approve/reject decision
The notes are labeled as system-generated
testCases.postconditions: Spam explanation notes are clear and helpful
